clips.title: The story
paras: Raising Spirits is a Horde quest that addresses the lingering emotional trauma of an old orc veteran. Through the guidance of Tor'gan, a shaman attempts to reach the embittered Gor'mul using ancestral magic to restore his lost pride and will to live.

In the wake of past wars, many orcish veterans struggle with the burdens of survival and perceived dishonor. Gor'mul is one such warrior, languishing in bitter despondency because he was denied what he considers an honorable death alongside his fallen Warchief. Tor'gan, an empathetic shaman, seeks to alleviate Gor'mul's suffering by reminding him of his people's spiritual strength. Believing that ancestral energies can heal emotional wounds, Tor'gan prepares an enchanted amulet intended to rekindle the old fighter's pride.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tor'gan sent you, didn't he? Pah! Why he feels some mercy towards me I would not understand. Mercy was denied me when I was not allowed to die with my Warchief in battle. A cruel blow fate has dealt me...

clips.title: Completion
paras: It did not work, I see. Nonetheless, I feel that showing him the power of the shamans will eventually return Gor'mul to his once proud self. The amulet's power was not great enough to show him our newfound power.
